item.title: Consulting with Clarity Under Constraints
item.description:
This is a placeholder business article. Its job is to exercise the new section and single-page templates while signaling the tone of the future site.

Premise

Good consulting work is not mainly about generating more options. It is about reducing confusion without hiding tradeoffs. A useful advisor helps a client understand what is true, what is risky, and what should happen next.

Placeholder Themes

  • Turning vague requirements into concrete delivery options
  • Explaining cost, timing, and scope without jargon
  • Recommending restraint when a client is not ready to build
  • Preserving trust by telling the truth early

Future Direction

The live version of this piece could draw from real consulting stories and business analysis work already described on the resume page.
